title: Monocular sequence sampling
text: Context frames come from one moving camera, each at its own instant; the target is another view and time. Sampling view and time asynchronously separates camera parallax from scene motion.

title: Frozen static prior
text: The pretrained static encoder (24 layers) and renderer stay frozen. They turn the context frames into a static latent that knows geometry and viewpoint, but not time.

title: Lightweight dynamic encoder
text: Eight layers with learnable time tokens cross-attend into the frozen static features and output a time-invariant residual latent plus a dynamic mask.

title: Target-time adaptation and rendering
text: A time module adapts the residual to the target time through a zero-initialised gate. Residual plus static latent is decoded by the frozen renderer at the target view.
